title: Men in suits arrive by helicopter and take the Princeton's radar data

tellings.quote: sailors aboard the Princeton I think that um people in suits landed in helicopters and took all the radar data.

plain: In 2004, after the Navy's encounter with the Tic Tac (a white oval object, shaped like the mint), men in suits are said to have landed by helicopter on the USS Princeton, a Navy warship, and taken all its radar data. A defense writer named Marik von Rennenkampff tells this, passing on, with an "I think", what sailors aboard said, including a sailor named Gary Voorhis. If true, it would mean someone moved fast to take the evidence.
